summary: Entravision Communications filed an 8-K on November 3, 2026, disclosing a purchase agreement to sell WFTT-TV, serving the Tampa-St. Petersburg, Florida market, to Sunset Boulevard Broadcasting Corporation for $30.0 million in cash. The deal is structured as a sale of the membership interests of the subsidiary holding the station. An affiliate of the buyer currently programs the station under a carriage agreement that terminates at closing. The agreement contains customary representations, warranties, covenants, indemnification and termination rights. Closing is subject to regulatory approval and customary conditions, expected in Q4 2026 or Q1 2027. Watch FCC approval timing and any purchase-price adjustment provisions.
